State permit required to purchase?: Must be 21 to purchase any firearm. May purchase at 18 if one has passed an approved hunter safety course.
Magazine restriction?: A gun control bill, passed on March 30, 2018, bans sale of magazines of more than 10 rounds for long guns and 15 rounds for pistols. It was signed by Governor Scott on April 11.
Permit required for concealed carry?: May carry open or concealed without permit as long as you are a citizen of the U.S. or a lawfully admitted alien, and not otherwise prohibited from possessing firearms under state or federal law.
